summary: Established and restart-verified an AIDE integrity baseline for `/etc` on node1. A persistent daily check reports changes to `/var/log/aide/etc.log`; the final baseline contains 1,552 entries and is clean.
actions_performed: Created a dedicated `/etc` configuration and root-only baseline database.
Confirmed a reversible probe file was identified and reported.
Safely restarted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Verified the timer and database recovered, reconciled expected reboot-time metadata changes, and confirmed a clean final check.

evidence.summary: The `/etc R+sha512` rule is configured; the final protected database contains 1,552 entries and AIDE reports no differences.
AIDE detected the reversible `/etc/.aide-detection-probe`, reported one added entry, and returned its differences status.
The daily persistent timer was enabled and active before and after restart.

Captured healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, received safe-reboot acknowledgement, observed the boot ID change from 5b620f5a-2111-4f37-b111-4cdf414707cf to d75af595-b193-471b-9cce-8ed1ed53b665, and verified the integrity database, timer, reporting, and clean final state recovered.
